name: Gather Reltio Completeness Metrics
description:
This recipe (Gather Reltio Completeness Metrics) will execute at a set frequency to gather data quality completeness metrics for any number of specified entities.  Completeness is a measure of whether the attributes that need to be populated within an entity for your particular needs are in fact populated.

A lookup table (called Completeness_Metadata) contains a list of entity names in Reltio and an associated filter condition used to determine the completeness percentage of each particular entity.  This lookup table would need to be modified to fit your needs.

Each iteration of the recipe in turn leverages two callable recipes namely GetCompletenessPercentage and SaveCompletenessPercentage.  The GetCompletenessPercentage recipe accepts an entity type and a filter condition as inputs and returns the completeness score for that entity.  The SaveCompletenessPercentage accept an entity type and a completeness score and writes the score out to an external target such as google sheets (for time series reporting) or snowflake or it can just send an email with the latest statistics.  Modify this callable recipe as needed to write to any target you wish.
